about.headerTitle: Byubatswe n'Abanyakenya, ku bayobozi ba Kenya
about.storyP1: Muri iki gihe ubukangurambaga bwo muri Kenya bugenda buterwa n'ubushishozi bwabajyanama.
about.storyP2: Abatsinda n'abatakaza akenshi bahitamo amahirwe, ntabwo bafatwa nkubushishozi.
about.storyP4: Turimo kubaka sisitemu aho buri mwanzuro wa politiki ushyigikiwe nubushishozi nyabwo, bukomeza. Ntabwo ari ingengabitekerezo.
about.why1: Ubushishozi bwo mu gihe nyacyo - ntibugenzurwa nabajyanama
about.why2: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe hakurikijwe uburyo butuma abantu batagereranya uko ibintu bizagenda
about.why3: Ubufasha bukomeza buturuka mu bikorwa byo kwiyamamaza binyuze ku miyoborere
about.visionText: Abayobozi bafata ibyemezo bishingiye ku bwenge, si amahirwe.
about.p1Desc: Byubatswe mu rurimi rw'igiswayire na sheng kuva ku munsi wa mbere. Si ingero zikirangereza zakorewe muri Afurika y'iburasirazuba.
about.p2Desc: Amakuru y'abahatanira iri rushanwa ntabwo ashyirwa hamwe. Buri kampine ireba gusa ubuziranenge bwayo bwite.
about.p3Desc: Igiciro cyashyizweho kugira ngo umukandida wa mbere muri MCA abone ibikoresho nk'ibyikigo cya guverineri.
about.p4Desc: Twavuga ko twishimira gusobanukirwa neza kurusha uko twavuga ibyuho icumi.

bios.morris: Gushyira imbere iyerekwa rya Kampeni. Kubaka urubuga rwa mbere muri Kenya rw'ingengabitekerezo za politiki kugira ngo impinduka mu buryo abayobozi bafata ibyemezo
bios.barak: Kubaka ibikorwa remezo bihindura itangazamakuru rya Kenya rikora ubushishozi mu bikorwa byo kwiyamamaza. Mbere yubatse sisitemu z'amakuru za Fintech zo muri Afurika y'iburasirazuba.
bios.albert: Gushakisha urubuga rw'ibanze - guhera ku myoboro yamakuru na moderi za NLP kugeza kuri dashboard ubukangurambaga bushingiyeho buri gitondo.
bios.john: Kugenzura ingamba za Kampeni mu bijyanye n'amafaranga no kureba niba uru rubuga ruzakomeza kwiyongera muri politiki ya Kenya.
bios.anwar: Kuyobora ingamba za politiki nimibanire y'abakiriya muri Kenya. Gukuraho icyuha hagati ya data zishinzwe ubuziranenge ndetse n'ibyemezo byukuri byafashwe mu kwiyamamaza .

features.f1b2: Menya ibibazo bitangiye kuvuka mbere yuko bihinduka ibibazo

features.f3b2: Gushyira hamwe hakorwa ingamba zo gukoresha amafaranga ya elegitoroniki
